description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a pulse diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency). Panels: 'lentil_ldp' = lentil diversity panel, 324 accessions, exome capture, CDC Redberry v2 (= LIS lentil gene IDs; KnowPulse); 'lentil_activate' = lentil diversity panel + ACTIVATE lines, 521 accessions, CDC Greenstar (Lcu.1GRN IDs; KnowPulse); 'faba_norfab' = NORFAB faba bean panel, 196 accessions shown as 'name, origin country (Core code)' from Skovbjerg et al. 2023 Supplementary File 1 where listed, SPET, Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 (Aarhus University).
gene: a lentil CDC Redberry v2 ID (Lcu.2RBY.1g000010), a CDC Greenstar ID (Lcu.1GRN.1g000010, for the
LDP + ACTIVATE panel), a curated lentil symbol (e.g. LcFIE), or an Ensembl faba bean v1 ID
(Vfaba.Hedin2.R1.1g000010, NORFAB). Matching genes in the other lentil assembly are tried too.
name: panel_haplotypes
